data_objects.name: olist_customers
data_objects.meaning: Brazilian marketplace customer records at one row per order-specific customer ID.

data_objects.name: olist_geolocation
data_objects.meaning: Geographic coordinates and locality labels observed for Brazilian postal-code prefixes.
data_objects.notes: Postal prefixes can appear more than once with different coordinate samples.

data_objects.name: olist_order_items
data_objects.meaning: Line items sold within marketplace orders, including product, seller, price, and freight.

data_objects.name: olist_order_payments
data_objects.meaning: Payment components associated with orders; an order may have sequential payment rows.

data_objects.name: olist_order_reviews
data_objects.meaning: Customer review scores, optional text, and review timing linked to orders.

data_objects.name: olist_orders
data_objects.meaning: Order-level status and purchase, approval, shipping, delivery, and estimated-delivery timestamps.

data_objects.name: olist_products
data_objects.meaning: Product catalog attributes, Portuguese category labels, text lengths, photo counts, weight, and dimensions.

data_objects.name: olist_sellers
data_objects.meaning: Seller identifiers and Brazilian locality information.

data_objects.name: olist_category_translation
data_objects.meaning: Mapping from Portuguese product-category labels to English labels.

data_objects.name: amazon_cell_phone_reviews
data_objects.meaning: Line-delimited Amazon review records for cell phones and accessories.

data_objects.name: ebay_laptop_listings
data_objects.meaning: Uncleaned eBay laptop and netbook listing attributes with values often embedded in display strings.

data_objects.name: amazon_cell_phone_metadata
data_objects.meaning: Line-delimited Amazon product metadata for cell phones and accessories.

structure.description: The Olist tables form a relational marketplace bundle centered on order_id; customer_id, product_id, and seller_id connect orders to their respective entities.
Postal-code prefixes connect customer and seller locality fields to geolocation samples; joins can be many-to-many because geolocation prefixes repeat.
Portuguese product categories map to English through product_category_name.
Amazon reviews and Amazon metadata join on asin; both files are line-delimited JSON rather than a single JSON array.
The Olist, Amazon, and eBay objects are separate source collections and have no declared cross-source key.

uncertainties: The source files do not provide an explicit currency declaration for every monetary field.
Some uncleaned display fields require parsing before numeric interpretation, and blanks or malformed values are possible.
annotation_notes: Annotation was derived from public file names, source headers, encodings, and representative records only.
